about: Written by tools/solver/scan_draw_observers.py; do not edit. Everything that acts on drawn cards (the draw loop's per-card calls, the draw-result readers, the AfterCardDrawn listeners), each classed in draw_observer_classes.json: an observer turns the macro draw off while its test in DrawObservers.All holds (FIGHT_SOLVER.md section 17).

draw-loop:Add.why: the drawn card lands in hand and in the draw's result list in draw order; the hand's order is read only where the key keeps the hand in order, and the macro draw is off there (hand-ordered); result readers are classed as draw-result

draw-loop:AutoPlayDrawnCard.why: plays a drawn Strike inside the draw (HellraiserPower.AfterCardDrawnEarly): what is played, and whether the rest is drawn, follow the order

draw-loop:BindOnDraw.why: binds the first cards drawn in the owner's turn, up to the power's amount (BoundCardsThisTurn): which cards are Bound follows the order

draw-loop:ConfuseCostOnDraw.why: Confused re-rolls a drawn card's cost on its own stream, independently per card; the roll is a chance call between draws, so a run of plain draws ends at it

draw-loop:CountDrawnCardForAutomation.why: Automation counts the cards drawn; the count, not the order, decides its energy

draw-loop:DamageAllForSpeedster.why: hits every enemy per card drawn mid-turn: a kill stops the draw at a fight's end, and a death's effects see the hand drawn so far

draw-loop:DrawForIteration.why: the first Status card drawn this turn draws more: the count drawn depends on the values, and where the extra cards land on the order

draw-loop:DrawForPagestorm.why: an Ethereal card drawn draws more: the count drawn depends on the values

draw-loop:Get.why: BuffSystem.Get: reads a buff for the Hellraiser test (classed with AutoPlayDrawnCard and IsStrikeCard)

draw-loop:GrowKinglyCardOnDraw.why: Kingly Kick and Kingly Punch grow per copy as they are drawn: the same for any order

draw-loop:IsOverOrEnding.why: the fight-end check before each card: the fight ends inside a draw only through an observer (Hellraiser's play, Speedster's hit); the safe effects here cannot kill

draw-loop:IsStrikeCard.why: Hellraiser's test of the drawn card

draw-loop:Max.why: a drawn Void's energy loss, Math.Max(0, energy - 1): the same total for any order

draw-loop:PoisonAllForCorrosiveWave.why: Corrosive Wave poisons every hittable enemy per card drawn: the same total for any order; poison does not hit until it ticks

draw-loop:ReferenceEquals.why: where a Hellraiser-played card came to rest (the Hellraiser path, an observer)

draw-loop:RemoveFromDrawPileAt.why: the take off the top: the draw itself, which the solver watches

draw-loop:RollSlitherCost.why: Slither re-rolls a drawn card's cost on its own stream, independently per card; the roll is a chance call, so a run of plain draws ends at it

draw-loop:ShuffleIfNecessary.why: a reshuffle inside the draw runs AfterShuffle, where Stratagem's pick opens a screen and puts a card of the player's choice in hand mid-draw; the reshuffle itself is safe (it comes at a count that does not depend on the order, and the solver keeps the reshuffle epoch)

draw-result:DrawUntilNonAttack.why: Pillage draws until it draws a non-Attack: the count drawn depends on the values and their order

draw-result:EscapePlan.why: draws one card and reads its type: a one-card draw is never a macro node

draw-result:Scrape.why: discards the cards it drew that do not cost 0, in draw order, through the discard command: discard triggers and Sly plays fire in that order

kernel-hook:AfterCardDrawn.why: a listener a switched-on kernel family (F11) registers on a drawn card: the kernel's listeners are not classed one by one, so while any is registered the draws are sequential
